reviews.text:
There's one grumpy and scary employee.

It's a shame because everyone else is so nice 😭
When I dropped off my dog ​​first thing in the morning, she was extremely grumpy 😑
If she hates it so much, she should just quit...
If she's going to take out her bad mood on people and cause trouble, she should do a remote job or something she can do herself 👌🏻 She should take care of her own mood. Even if she's just unfriendly, she's not suited for reception work, so she should find a job that suits her 👌🏻
I always use this pet hotel and grooming service. All the staff are kind and I love this store.

I've been a customer for many years, but occasionally there are staff members with grumpy attitudes.
When I make reservations by phone or drop off my dog, I always hope that this person won't be there. However, I recently went when that person (or perhaps a different staff member, since it's been a while) was there. When I handed over my dog, even though I was holding him, the staff member took him by the harness. My dog ​​ended up dangling in mid-air from the harness, which shocked me.
For another dog, when I handed over the leash, the staff member didn't move, and my dog ​​was being pulled forcefully, so I instinctively picked him up and handed him over.

I've been a customer for many years, and I'm always satisfied with the results. There are also some wonderful, smiling groomers, so it's very disappointing.

I would like to continue using your services, so I wrote this in the hope that you will improve.

He's become so much cuter since coming here. 
I feel safe staying overnight, and although he used to be timid, he's now very dependent on the staff here.

The staff member had an incredibly bad attitude.

This is the first time I've encountered such a rude pet hotel. ☺️
It was very unpleasant. I'm worried about my dog.

I decided to switch from the grooming salon I had been going to for three years. From the prior communication to the day of the appointment, the LINE correspondence was quick and courteous. One of the dogs had a slight case of diarrhea, which worried me, but they shared their condition and how they were feeling when I picked them up. The price is very reasonable for this area. I would like to ask again.

Maybe it's because they're busy? The telephone service is bad. I'd like them to provide a more pleasant service since they can't see me.
The Shibuya store doesn't have a monitoring camera. Check the Instagram story they'll post in the evening, they said. I wish they'd make it clear that they don't provide service.
The impression I got when I met them in person wasn't bad.
